changelog:
architecture-generator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the architecture-generator skill.
- Generate toy design drafts, multi-view sheets, and 3D models from text or image prompts.
- Supports templates for figurine, stuffed toy, 3D printing, game assets, and architecture toys.
- Integrates with OneKey Agent Gateway; requires a registered API access key.
- Includes endpoints for creating, polling, and designing toy generation tasks.
- Provides asset size templates and comprehensive workflow documentation.
summary: AI Architecture Toy Generator Generate Toy Multi View Sheets and 3D Models Generator using SOTA 3D APIs such as Tripo/Meshy/etc served on OneKey Agent Gateway by Craftsman Agent, useful for AI Figurine, Stuffed Toy, 3D Printing, Game Asset and Architecture Toy Generation
